title: Run-Length Encoding
text: Run-length encoding compresses repeated sequences by storing each symbol alongside its consecutive count.

title: Huffman Coding
text: Huffman coding assigns short bit codes to frequent symbols and longer codes to rare symbols.

title: Lempel-Ziv-Welch Compression
text: Lempel-Ziv-Welch compression builds a dictionary of strings seen so far and outputs dictionary indices.

title: Delta Encoding
text: Delta encoding stores the difference between successive values instead of each full value.

title: Thermal Conduction
text: Thermal conduction transfers heat through direct contact between neighboring particles, without bulk movement.

title: Convection
text: Convection transfers heat by the bulk motion of a fluid such as a liquid or gas.

title: Thermal Radiation
text: Thermal radiation carries energy by electromagnetic waves and requires no material medium.

title: Latent Heat
text: During melting or boiling, a substance absorbs latent heat while its temperature remains constant.

title: Antibodies
text: Antibodies bind specific antigens and can neutralize pathogens or mark them for destruction.

title: T Cells
text: Helper T cells coordinate immune responses, while cytotoxic T cells destroy infected cells.

title: Vaccines
text: Vaccines expose the immune system to a harmless antigen or its instructions, building memory against later infection.

title: Complement System
text: The complement system is a group of blood proteins that mark microbes and can damage their membranes.
